metadata.question: Was the Antarctic ozone hole larger on October 7, 2021 than compared to its area on January 1, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for ozone data (OFFL/L3_O3 product) - Alternative: Use total column ozone or ozone hole specific products - Dates: October 7, 2021 vs January 1, 2021 - Location: Antarctic region (centered around South Pole) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify ozone hole (typically defined as areas where total column ozone < 220 Dobson Units) - Focus on Antarctic region - October is during Antarctic spring when ozone hole is typically largest - January is Antarctic summer when ozone hole is typically smallest/absent 3. Logic: - Calculate area of ozone hole for both dates - Compare areas: October 7 > January 1 = A, otherwise B - Handle cases: no data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), calculation failure (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Antarctic region const antarctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]], null, false ); // Dates const date1 = '2021-01-01'; const date2 = '2021-10-07'; // Get Sentinel-5P ozone data const ozoneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') .select('O3_column_number_density') .filterBounds(antarctic); // Get data for January 1, 2021 const jan_col = ozoneCol.filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-01-02'); const jan_size = jan_col.size().getInfo(); console.log('January 1 images:', jan_size); if (jan_size === 0) { console.log('No data for January 1, 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get data for October 7, 2021 const oct_col = ozoneCol.filterDate('2021-10-07', '2021-10-08'); const oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo(); console.log('October 7 images:', oct_size); if (oct_size === 0) { console.log('No data for October 7, 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create mosaics const jan_img = jan_col.mean(); const oct_img = oct_col.mean(); // Convert to Dobson Units (multiply by 2241.15) const jan_ozone = jan_img.multiply(2241.15); const oct_ozone = oct_img.multiply(2241.15); // Define ozone hole: areas where ozone < 220 DU const jan_hole = jan_ozone.lt(220); const oct_hole = oct_ozone.lt(220); // Calculate area of ozone hole in square km const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); const jan_area_result = jan_hole.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const oct_area_result = oct_hole.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const jan_area = jan_area_result.get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); const oct_area = oct_area_result.get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log('January 1, 2021 ozone hole area (km²):', jan_area); console.log('October 7, 2021 ozone hole area (km²):', oct_area); // Validate results if (jan_area === null || oct_area === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(jan_area) || isNaN(oct_area)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare areas if (oct_area > jan_area) { console.log('October ozone hole is larger'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('October ozone hole is not larger'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
